answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks using proofs of space-time. Nodes dedicate physical drive sectors to cryptographic plots, answering sequential challenges issued by a raven audit daemon. This forces adversaries to commit scarce non-volatile storage per identity rather than offloading claims to a cheap glacier tier, maintaining verified uptime above an eviction ledge. However, high I/O churn causes hardware degradation and favors centralized data centers.
